content: Guijin Onu Xianxin Gieku Wo
Jialataini guazi kunlaya! Kien tai miiwo? Ersa Mexihani shizijia jiere ghadazhi qinchude tai melie beilawo.
Bi tande jianie shiqin asaye, ta Shenlinni jienliesanshi guijinni zunjikughala onu gouxioxini sonosudene xianxin giekughala wo?
Ta Shenlinghala kaishi giedene beyeghala jieshu olughanu? Tashi intu guazi onu?
Ta imeghei shouku giesanshi belienni onu? Bebelieghanji onu?
Huda tande Shenlinni ogizhi tai dunda nenlitu shiqin giesanshi ta guijinni zunjikughala onu gouxioxini sonosudene xianxin giekughala wo?
Jinwun jiere jilasan mutun, "Iburaheimu Hudai xianxin giedene Huda hhei gounide sanazho."
Ingiese xianxin giesanlashi Iburaheimui houdei bikui ta mejie.
Niman kunlai xianxin giekughala Huda gounide sanakui jinwun jiere melie kieliezho. Ingie eqighanse Iburaheimude gouxioxini chonjizhi kieliezho, "Chii tungo giezhi soyuji minzulade fuqi irene."
Ingiese xianxin giesan kunla xianxin giesan Iburaheimure hhantu fuqi jienliene.
Guijinni zunjikude kouisan kunla man kharaku doura wo. Jinwun jiere jilasan mutun, "Guijinshu jiere jilasanlai man ulie zunjizhi ulie giesanlai man kharane."
Guijinni kouizhi kiemai Hudai melie gounide sana daku qinchu wo. Jinwun jiere kieliezho, "Gou kun xianxin giekughala amiturane."
Guijin xianxin giekughala buxian wo. Jinwun jiere kieliesan mutun, "Guijinni zunjisan kunla guijinni kouizhi amiturane."
Jien mutun jiere gualasanlai kharane giezhi jinwun jiere jilasan mutun Mexiha matande oluzhi kharakui shouizhi guijinni kharakuse matai shuiwo.
Ingiedene Iburaheimude ogisan fuqi Mexiha Ersai tungo giezhi niman kunlade kuruwo, matan xianxin giekui tungo giezhi dain giesan Shenlinni jienliewo.
Guijin Dain Giesanghala
Gaijiula, bi nie pinchanku bifanyi kielieye. Kun kielien yenjise kiema widagha daji jiai dane.
Huda Iburaheimu, hhei houdeide dain giekude olon kunyi zhiizhi chii houdeila giezhi ese kieliedene niekozii zhiizhi chii houdei giezho. Hheshi Mexiha wo.
Mii isishi ingiezho. 430 nien daodene iresan guijin melieshida Huda yenjisei widagha dazhi dain giesei widagha dane.
Hudai jiachan guijinse irezhoshi dain giesanse ese irezho, ingieliuzhe Huda Iburaheimude dain giesei tungo giezhi ogizho.
Qinse guijinshi yan wo? Guijinshi Iburaheimude dain giesan houdei iretula zuini mejieghane giezhi jiaisan wo. Guijinshi qienxienlai tungo giezhi dundadu kunyi khai jingo giezhi jinjisan wo.
Dundadu kunshi shonfanmienyi daibio giezhoma, Hudashi nie wo.
Musani Guijinni Zoin
Ingiese guijin Hudai dain giesanghala zodui giezhou? Kenjin uye! Amin ireghaku guijinni ogizhoshi kunla hhei tungo giezhi gounide sanawo.
Ingiezhoma, soyuji kunlai zuide qienji jiezho giezhi jinwun jiere kieliezho. Ingiedene Ersa Mexihai xianxin giezhi iresan dainni xianxin giesan kunlade ogizho.
Xianxin gieku iretula matai guijin doura khazhi xianxin gieku xienjizhi khizhetula uzhezho.
Ingiese guijinshi Mexiha iretula mai uduruku loushi wo. Ingiedene xianxin giekughala mai gounide sanaghazho.
Ede xianxin gieku irese matan hhe uduruku loushii doura uwo.
Ta man Mexiha Ersai xianxin giekughala Hudai kewosi gholuwo.
Xilii jienliezhi Mexihare hhantulasan ta man jierene Mexihai musizho.
Ta Mexiha Ersai miende man nie wo. Yutai kun, niman kun, ziyutu kun, hoji, ere kun, eme kunla yama chabie uwo.
Tashi Mexihanughunshi Iburaheimui houdei wo, dain giesanzhe caichanni jienliechen wo.
